prompt: Build the community engagement package for the iron condor October P&L video: pinned comment, community-tab post launching the day of publish, and 3 in-video CTA hooks. Voice must match brand. Marcus persona reads comments often but rarely posts.
raw_output: The pinned comment doubles down on the differentiator — names the losing trade and previews the November plan — to start the comment thread with substance rather than CTAs. The community-tab post drops on publish day with a poll: most of the audience won't comment but will vote, which surfaces engagement to the algorithm cheaply. The three in-video CTA hooks are positioned at retention soft-spots (3:00, 9:15, 17:00) and ask for a specific reply, not a generic 'subscribe'.

structured_output.pinned_comment: Quick notes on the TSLA trade at 9:15 — I rolled the call side too late. If I'd adjusted on the Wednesday before earnings instead of Friday morning, that's a $1,200 swing. November plan: sitting out the first FOMC week and running condors on SPX every other Friday. Drop your November questions below — I'll answer the top 10 in next week's video.

community_post.body:
October P&L is live. Quick question while you watch: what's the biggest reason you HAVEN'T sold iron condors yet?
• Don't understand the setup
• Scared of the max loss
• Don't have enough capital
• I already do — show me adjustments
community_post.follow_up_body: Top reason on the poll was 'scared of max loss'. Next week's video walks through exactly how I size every condor so the max loss is a number I can stomach. Drop your account size in the comments and I'll work an example for the median number.

in_video_hooks.cta: If you've never placed an iron condor before, comment 'condor 101' and I'll pin a free setup checklist.
Quick interruption — this is the trade that broke. Want the full post-mortem as its own video? Comment 'TSLA breakdown'.
November plan in the description. Tell me which week YOU'RE sitting out and why.
